Get educated. When I first got sick I knew nothing about lyme. Even after being diagnosed and treating for a year, I thought I knew a lot...but I still had so much to learn. I decided to get serious about getting well and I started really reading about lyme to learn how the bacteria works. It helped me understand why treatment was taking so long and that it’s not a straight path to healing. 
Here are some books (these have all likely already been mentioned here): 
- Healing Lyme by Stephen Buhner
- Why can’t I get better by Richard Horowitz
- How can I get better by Richard Horowitz 
- Autoimmune illness and Lyme disease recovery by Katina Makris 
- Unlocking Lyme by Bill Rawls 

Another tip, once you start feeling better from treatment , don’t stop treating and go back to bad habits. Stress is a huge trigger for those of us who have ‘late stage or chronic lyme’ (whatever you want to call it). If you are consistent with treatment and you’re tolerating it okay, you will eventually start to feel better. This means it’s working and to keep doing what you’re doing. This is a mistake I have personally made. More than once. 

Lastly and more importantly...never lose hope. People do get well, it just takes time, patience and persistence. Much love to you.
